reviews.title: High value workstation 3090: 2 slot is key
reviews.comment: So far, this card has been an excellent value. With a 2 slot form factor, excellent for tight case fitment in my ATX or iATX forms. Benchmark shows it performs too: MSI Afterburner and Furmark.
reviews.author: Long Strategic Advisors LLC

reviews.title: Overpriced but solid card
reviews.comment: While definitely over priced, and hard to find, Gigabyte no longer makes this model, so it's a one of a kind. I've been using it about 2 months now without a hitch, and I get all the performance expected of a 3090. The blower style is loud to some, but coming from a blower style 5700 XT, I am satisfied with it's performance. With my headphone, I don't hear a thing. I guess if you're in a library it might be a concern.
reviews.author: MandalorianGamer
